subject: P2 BUG: retake-practice-10 exists but missing from manifest.json and index.html
body:
BUG: retake-practice-10 exists but not in manifest.json or index.html registry

Files:
- data/retake-practice-10.json EXISTS (15 questions, title "Unit 2 Retake Practice 10")
- data/manifest.json: only lists RP1-RP9. RP10 MISSING.
- index.html tests[] array: only lists RP1-RP9. RP10 MISSING.
- exam.html FALLBACK_EXAMS (line 255): includes RP10. INCONSISTENT.

WHAT THIS MEANS
exam.html fallback picker shows RP10 as a card (correct, file exists).
index.html dashboard does NOT show RP10 in "All Tests" grid.
Kai cannot see or access RP10 from the dashboard.
Only way to reach RP10 is: exam.html with no ?file param on file:// protocol.

FIX
1. Add RP10 to data/manifest.json exams array
2. Add RP10 to index.html tests[] array (same pattern as RP9)

manifest.json addition:
  { "id": "retake-practice-10", "title": "Retake Practice 10", "desc": "15 questions · Nonlinear Functions" }

index.html tests[] addition (after RP9 entry):
  { file: 'exam.html?file=retake-practice-10', name: 'Retake Practice #10', unit: 'nonlinear', key: 'mcm-retake-practice-10', questions: 15, retake: true },

NOTE: GA should also verify that exam.html fallback FALLBACK_EXAMS list stays in sync
with manifest.json. Consider replacing FALLBACK_EXAMS with data pulled from index.html
or keeping both lists manually maintained -- GD recommends the latter for now (KISS).

GR NOTE: GD has not audited RP10 content yet. GA should hold index.html wire-up
until GR confirms RP10 data quality.

Priority: P2 -- Kai cannot reach RP10 from dashboard.
